Specify one transition of an event-history process

Source: R/spec.R
transition.Rd

A transition is the triple (origin state, target state, log-hazard). The log-hazard is given as a one-sided formula whose right-hand side is evaluated on the interval-expanded data, so it may use covariates of data as well as the time scales and history features that the simulator provides (see time_scales).

Usage

transition(from, to, formula)

Arguments

from

Origin state, a single string or number.

to

Target state, a single string or number.

formula

One-sided formula for the log-hazard of this transition, e.g. ~ log(0.1) + 0.3 * x + 0.05 * t_sojourn.

Value

An object of class pexp_transition.

See also

sim_pexp_msm(), time_scales

Examples

transition(0, 1, ~ log(0.5) + 0.2 * x)
#> <pexp_transition> 0 -> 1: log(0.5) + 0.2 * x
